{{Quote|This is Kalani. I assure you he will succeed where you have failed.|Count Dooku to King Sanjay Rash|<ref name="Front Runners">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref>}}
'''Kalani''' was a [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] [[General/Legends|general]] in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] was sent by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to aid [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in order to crush [[Onderon rebels/Legends|those who resisted]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] occupation. However, after continued resistance, Kalani and Dooku came to the conclusion that the fighting on Onderon was getting nowhere, and as such Dooku ordered the Confederacy to abandon the planet. With the retreat in motion, Kalani turned on and [[Death/Legends|executed]] Rash.

==Biography==
[[File:General_Kalani_Force_Collection.png|thumb|left|150px|General Kalani, droid tactician]]
Kalani was a [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] with the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Kalani was eventually sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] to take over the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederate military]] operations there that were constantly under threat of [[Onderon rebels/Legends|local resistance]]. The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sent Kalani to the planet while under the impression that the world's [[King/Legends|king]], [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], needed a stronger tactician to deal with the planet's rebel forces.

Kalani demanded that he be informed of all available facts. When [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]], Rash's native general, failed to show evidence of the [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] rebel leaders, [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela]] and [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]], Kalani argued that he was being provided with insufficient information. Though Tandin pleaded with Rash to allow the military to handle the rebels, Kalani refused, stating that they may have sympathizers among the military ranks.

After Saw Gerrera was captured while trying to rescue the former king, [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]], Kalani and Tandin oversaw his [[Torture/Legends|torture]] and interrogation. When Tandin showed compassion for Gerrera's pain, Kalani was intrigued but unimpressed.

Kalani was later present when Rash attempted to have Dendup publicly [[Attempted execution of Ramsis Dendup and Saw Gerrera/Legends|executed]]. The super tactical droid correctly calculated that the rebels would attack and was able to capture them using an ambush by [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. Tandin, however, turned against Rash, and with the help of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was able to escape Kalani's ambush.

The resistance soon began to step up their efforts. Dendup announced to all of Iziz via holograms of Rash's tyrannical rule and urged that they support the rebels. The common Onderonian people then initiated riots across the city. Rash then began to worry that the droid army will be spread too thin to combat both the rebels and the riots. Kalani initiated his solution and orchestrated an attack on the rebel hideout with newly designed droid gunships. After the attack failed due to the interference of the Jedi and the pirate [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], Kalani was present when King Rash once again appealed to Dooku for more assistance. Dooku listened to Kalani's report on the situation before agreeing that Onderon was a lost cause and ordering a withdrawal of the Separatist forces there to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. Kalani unceremoniously raised a blaster and executed the king as he sat on his throne.

==Behind the scenes==
Kalani was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, and made his series debut in the episode [[Front Runners]], which focused on the battle of Onderon. Kalani appeared in two more episodes dealing with the story arc, [[The Soft War]] and [[Tipping Points]]. Kalani later appeared in the mobile [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'', as a rare five-star rated card.
